def calculate_time(n, k, passwords, correct_password):
    # Sort passwords by their lengths
    passwords.sort(key=len)
    
    # Find the index of the correct password
    correct_index = passwords.index(correct_password)
    
    # Calculate the best case time
    best_case_time = 1  # Vanya enters the correct password on the first try
    
    # Calculate the worst case time
    worst_case_time = 0
    wrong_tries = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        if i < correct_index:
            # Vanya tries all shorter passwords
            worst_case_time += 1
            if len(passwords[i]) < len(passwords[correct_index]):
                wrong_tries += 1
            else:
                # If he tries a password of the same length, he might get it wrong
                wrong_tries += 1
                worst_case_time += 1
        elif i > correct_index:
            # Vanya tries all longer passwords
            worst_case_time += 1
            if len(passwords[i]) > len(passwords[correct_index]):
                wrong_tries += 1
            else:
                # If he tries a password of a longer length, he might get it wrong
                wrong_tries += 1
                worst_case_time += 1
    
    # Add the time for blocked access
    worst_case_time += (wrong_tries // k) * 5
    
    return best_case_time, worst_case_time
